answer: Trace each agent funding back to its source and charge an escalating bond for every extra identity fed from the same vault: the first stakes a little, the tenth stakes tenfold, the thousandth stakes a fortune. A sybil farmer can mint clones for free, but every clone must be funded, and the funding vine betrays the shared root, so the network prices an identity by its place in that vine. Honest agents hold one identity and pay once, while a clone army cost grows superlinearly; a steady pulse of verified work slowly refunds the bond, so real newcomers are never priced out.
